sources.note: Owner research in issue #379 (pattern 1): automatic switching services, compared by Stiftung Warentest in Finanztest 09/2025. No page was fetched for this file.

route: Join an automatic switching service once; it takes the contract over and switches it every year, and the new provider handles the cancellation. Free services come before paid ones, and no service is named here for money.
person_does: Pick a service from the Finanztest 09/2025 comparison, free ones first, and sign up on its own site.
Confirm the sign-up to your assistant, and later each yearly switch when its confirmation arrives.
